definitions.explanation: A religious ceremony held to commemorate and pray for the deceased at specific intervals after death. Common occasions include the 7th day, 49th day, and annual anniversaries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法要|ほうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}んだ→営む：11837_itonamu⟧。
{法要|ほうよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親族|しんぞく}→親族：14199_shinzoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Relatives gathered for the memorial service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一周忌|いっしゅうき}→一周忌：06018_isshuuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法要|ほうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: We plan to hold the first anniversary memorial service.

notes:
{法要|ほうよう} is a Buddhist ceremony to commemorate the deceased.

KEY MEMORIAL OCCASIONS:
- ⟦{初七日|しょなのか}→初七日：06016_shonanoka⟧: 7th day
- ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧: 49th day (very important)
- ⟦{一周忌|いっしゅうき}→一周忌：06018_isshuuki⟧: 1st anniversary
- ⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧: 3rd year (actually 2nd anniversary)
- ⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：28963_nanakaiki⟧: 7th year

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法要|ほうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to hold a memorial service
- {法要|ほうよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加：02498_sanka⟧: to attend a memorial service
